entry.name: ZoomMin
entry.label: Smallest zoom the overview reaches (1.0 is native scale).

entry.name: ZoomStep
entry.label: Zoom factor per wheel notch.

entry.name: GridBase
entry.label: Minor grid spacing in canvas pixels.

entry.name: GridOctaveFactor
entry.label: Each coarser grid octave is this many times larger.

entry.name: GridOctaves
entry.label: Number of grid octaves drawn.

entry.name: TileImage
entry.label: Optional image tiled across the canvas at 1:1. Empty draws the grid.

entry.name: BorderActivate
entry.label: Screen edges and corners that open the canvas (written by the Screen Edges settings page). 0 top, 1 top-right, 2 right, 3 bottom-right, 4 bottom, 5 bottom-left, 6 left, 7 top-left.

entry.name: TouchBorderActivate
entry.label: Touch screen edges that open the canvas.

entry.name: HudPosition
entry.label: Where the toolbar sits on the primary display: Top, TopLeft, TopRight, Bottom, BottomLeft, BottomRight, Left, Right.

entry.name: HudShape
entry.label: Toolbar shape: auto (square in a corner, horizontal on the top or bottom edge, vertical on a side), or horizontal, vertical, square.

entry.name: OpenZoom
entry.label: View when the canvas opens: "fit" zooms to every window and frame, "1" stays at 1:1, any other number is a zoom anchored at the screen centre.

entry.name: KeyApply
entry.label: Keys that apply and close, as Qt key names without the Key_ prefix, comma separated.

entry.name: KeyHome
entry.label: Look through the current activity's frames.

entry.name: KeyOrigin
entry.label: Camera to the canvas origin.

entry.name: KeyPan
entry.label: Held while dragging to pan from anywhere.

entry.name: MouseFocusWindow
entry.label: Gesture on a window that applies with it focused: Click or DoubleClick, with optional Shift+, Ctrl+, Alt+, Meta+.

entry.name: FramesCarryWindows
entry.label: Dragging an activity's frames on the canvas carries that activity's windows with them, keeping their positions on screen. Off, the frames move over the windows.

entry.name: FocusTarget
entry.label: Where the viewport goes when a double-click applies with a window focused. "window": the point clicked stays under the pointer at 1:1 and the activity's frames move to make that so. "desktop": a window inside a frame leaves the frame where it is; one outside every frame gets the frame centred on it.

entry.name: MouseGotoActivity
entry.label: Gesture on an activity frame that applies with that activity current.

entry.name: MouseZoomToActivity
entry.label: Gesture on an activity frame that zooms the camera to that activity's frames (the toolbar swatches do this on a click).

entry.name: MouseSelect
entry.label: Gesture on a window that selects it alone.

entry.name: MouseSelectAdd
entry.label: Gesture on a window that adds it to the selection; its modifier plus a drag on the ground selects by rectangle.

entry.name: MouseSelectToggle
entry.label: Gesture on a window that toggles its selection.

entry.name: Palette
entry.label: Colour scheme for activities: default, okabe-ito (colour-blind safe), tol (colour-blind safe), ibm (colour-blind safe), mono (luminance steps only).

entry.name: SnapEdges
entry.label: Snap window and frame edges to other windows and frames while dragging.

entry.name: SnapCorners
entry.label: Snap corners to other corners while dragging.

entry.name: SnapGrid
entry.label: Snap positions to the canvas grid while dragging.

entry.name: SnapGridSize
entry.label: Grid step in canvas pixels for snap to grid.

entry.name: SnapDistance
entry.label: Snap when within this many screen pixels.

entry.name: MouseContextMenu
entry.label: Gesture on a window that opens the arrange menu for the selection.

entry.name: ArrangeGap
entry.label: Gap in canvas pixels between arranged windows.

entry.name: MouseNewActivityAt
entry.label: Gesture on a window outside every frame that creates an activity centred on it.

entry.name: ToggleShortcut
entry.label: Key sequence that opens and closes the canvas.

entry.name: HomeShortcut
entry.label: Key sequence that returns to the canvas origin.

entry.name: PanLeftShortcut
entry.label: Key sequence that pans one step left at 1:1 (a slide), or moves the open canvas's camera. No default: every Meta+arrow chord is taken by KWin.

entry.name: PanModeShortcut
entry.label: Key sequence held to pan the desktop with the mouse at 1:1: while it is down, every left or middle drag pulls the desktop along; releasing it settles the windows where they landed. Escape slides back.

entry.name: PanModePassthrough
entry.label: In pan mode, hand pointer input over windows to the real windows through the kwin-canvas-passthrough plugin when it is loaded: clicks, drags inside a window, wheel, and raise on click. Title bars and edges stay the canvas's, so a drag there moves the window on the plane.

entry.name: PanStep
entry.label: One pan step as a fraction of the screen (0.05 to 1).

entry.name: PanDuration
entry.label: Length of the slide animation in milliseconds. 0 jumps.

entry.name: PanSwipeFingers
entry.label: Touchpad swipe with this many fingers pans at 1:1, following the fingers. 0 turns it off. KWin's own three-finger swipes switch desktops and four-finger swipes open Overview; a matching count fires both.

entry.name: ActivityGap
entry.label: Gap in canvas pixels between the frame groups of neighbouring activities when first laid out.

entry.name: HiddenFrames
entry.label: Frames switched off from their tag, as "activityId|outputName". A hidden frame is not drawn and takes no windows.

entry.name: FollowActivation
entry.label: Pan the canvas so an activated off-screen window comes on screen.

entry.name: PublishGround
entry.label: Write the ground offset to the kwin-canvas-ground wallpaper via plasmashell.

entry.name: AutoActivate
entry.label: Open the canvas as soon as the effect loads (nested test harness).

entry.name: DebugCommand
entry.label: Command executed on reconfigure when DebugSeq changes (nested test harness).
